hero.subtitle: Shared round-trip transport from Mexico City | Approximately 40-minute flight | Pyramids

description.title: Stress-Free from Door to Sky
description.paragraph: An all-in-one experience with shared round-trip transport from Mexico City, a balloon flight, breakfast buffet, and up to two hours of independent access to the archaeological zone. We coordinate the logistics so you can focus on enjoying the day.

steps.title: 5:00 AM - Arrive & Check-in
steps.description: You’ll arrive at Flying Pictures Reception, where our team will welcome you and help you complete check-in.

steps.title: Welcome & Coffee Break
steps.description: After you complete your check-in we will welcome you with our coffee station with hot beverages and traditional cookies.

steps.title: The Inflation Spectacle
steps.description: Walk to the launch field to watch the "Giants" come to life. Seeing the massive balloons rise with the roar of the burners is the first act of the show.

steps.title: The Ascent
steps.description: Lift off gently into the dawn. For approx. 45-60 minutes, float silently over the Valley of Teotihuacán, watching the sun reveal the pyramids from above.

steps.title: The 1783 Toast
steps.description: Upon landing, we celebrate with a traditional sparkling wine toast. A ritual dating back to the first aviators to thank the wind gods for a safe return.

included: Shared round-trip transport between Mexico City and Teotihuacán
Coffee break with cookies and traditional Mexican drinks
Sparkling-wine toast or a non-alcoholic option
Independent admission to the archaeological zone for up to two hours
notIncluded: $110 MXN per-person fee for non-resident foreign visitors
recommendedExtras: Upgrade flight and transport to private for $4,999 MXN
Photos and video during the flight
notes: Archaeological-zone access is independent and does not include a guide.
Non-resident foreign visitors pay an additional $110 MXN per person upon arrival.
The Mexico City pickup point and time are confirmed with the booking.

steps.title: Meet us in Mexico City
steps.description: We collect you at the confirmed meeting point for the trip to Teotihuacán.

steps.title: Travel to the Globoport
steps.description: Enjoy the journey while our team handles the logistics.

steps.title: Have a coffee break
steps.description: Coffee, cookies, and traditional Mexican drinks await you upon arrival.

steps.title: Watch the balloons inflate
steps.description: See the aircraft preparation up close before take-off.

steps.title: Begin the ascent
steps.description: The pilot takes off when weather and operating conditions are suitable.

steps.title: Fly for approximately 40 minutes
steps.description: Take in views of the Teotihuacán Valley from the air.

steps.title: Toast and enjoy the breakfast buffet
steps.description: Celebrate the flight, receive your certificate, and have breakfast.

steps.title: Explore the archaeological zone
steps.description: Use up to two hours to explore independently with admission included.

steps.title: Travel back to Mexico City
steps.description: Return to the agreed point after the visit.
